charter: Improve the actual result quality of every actionable scanner in the system until validated and integrated into production.

event_identity_rules.independence_definition: Observations sharing setup_id are grouped into a single cluster for bootstrap and independence analysis.

pit_rule: For all features: feature_timestamp <= decision_timestamp. Any violation is tagged PIT_VIOLATION and excluded.

promotion_criteria.ranking: Positive incremental economic value (Delta Net E[R] > 0), positive rank monotonicity (Top20 > Mid60 > Bottom20), Delta MaxDD <= 0, stable across symbols/regimes.
promotion_criteria.filtering: Delta Net E[R] > 0, Delta MaxDD <= 0, Retention >= 70%, 95% CI lower bound > 0.
promotion_criteria.risk_control: Measurable risk reduction, acceptable return impact, acceptable opportunity cost.
promotion_criteria.forward_evidence_gate: N >= 50 genuinely new independent eligible observations, >= 15 unique symbols, >= 5 trading days, >= 2 market regimes, <= 20% max concentration per symbol.

EOD.baseline_definition: Production-valid trading baseline evaluated strictly on clean non-zero target geometry (+1.100R on N=26 clean records).
EOD.current_blocker: Awaiting N >= 50 forward alerts across >= 15 symbols to prove cross-symbol robustness beyond RELIANCE.

MULTI_TF.baseline_definition: To be established post-repair of mock execution levels and price scale normalization.
MULTI_TF.current_blocker: Mock ₹129.50 entry levels and zero target distance require telemetry re-hydration.

MULTIBAGGER.baseline_definition: To be established post-rehydration of 815 missing target/stop geometries.
MULTIBAGGER.current_blocker: 815 of 816 historical records require target/SL rehydration and forward bar replay simulation.

REVERSAL.baseline_definition: Production-valid trading baseline on verified execution mechanics (-1.05R on n=1 valid replay).
REVERSAL.current_blocker: Historical sample size insufficient (n=1). Awaiting forward market events to reach N >= 50.

PULLBACK.baseline_definition: To be established post-rehydration of target geometries across 12,885 records.
PULLBACK.current_blocker: 100% of historical records require target geometry rehydration and forward replay simulation.

DAILY_BUILDER.baseline_definition: To be established post-rehydration of intraday price paths across 35 records.
DAILY_BUILDER.current_blocker: Intraday price paths and session boundary termination require rehydration.

WEALTH_ENGINE.baseline_definition: Portfolio allocation metrics (CAGR, MaxDD, benchmark-relative return, turnover drag) instead of trade R.
